# binjgb browser core

This directory vendors the browser build of [binji/binjgb](https://github.com/binji/binjgb) at commit
`c60e138da5a795ebb55e56b11b7e90024e41112c` under its MIT license.

Only the emulator runtime is included. No commercial or homebrew ROM content is bundled.
